scope: Actual moving Three renderer on an owned bright background; default camera, tone mapping and Daylight profile. Selected visual phases, not live microphone/voice or production automatic-state proof. No pixel edits. Screenshots are sampled at observed wall times, not synchronized clip-frame numbers.
